programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness drömmer Rob, Steelo och Carly Aquilino en 'Nagelmardröm', ramlar i plurret i 'Krossade kanor' och är med om 'Oturliga starter'.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Den 17 november 1994 gick Bob Dylan in i Sony Studios i New York City för att spela in ett historiskt framträdande för MTV Unplugged med avskalade tolkningar av hans största hits.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Tio legendariska deltagare är tillbaka och måste direkt tampas i tre omgångar för att klara sig kvar. Kampen om 250 000 dollar och titeln Ink Master fortsätter.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Allianser börjar bildas när den första blixtutmaningen prövar tatuerarnas kreativitet. Sen får tatuerarna skapa museivärdiga verk i en eliminering.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness hälsar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood gästen Dee Snider välkommen för att träffa rebeller i 'Tänker inte tåla det', bevittnar band som stretar på i 'Kommer inte slå igenom' och upplever sorgen i att spilla ut kaffet i 'Kaffetragedier'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt av Ridiculousness tar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood en titt på konsekvenserna av att inte se skyltar i 'Skyltblind', lär sig udda fakta i 'Tekniskt sett sant' och får erfara hur galet det kan gå i 'Galnare och galnare'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt av Ridiculousness ser Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood cyklister bli otrevligt överraskade i 'Oväntade cykelhinder', träffar på elaka katter i 'Kattvrede' innan de slutligen ser folk fastna i 'Skallfällor'.

programme.title: Ink Master: Redemption
programme.desc: Dukar med minnestatueringar de vill glömma återvänder för att konfrontera tatuerarna som har kränkt dem. Jesse Smith och King Ruck återvänder.

programme.title: Ink Master: Redemption
programme.desc: Den nervöse Alex Rockoff från sjunde säsongen återvänder till studion med inte en eller två utan tre missnöjda dukar. Kan han svälja stoltheten för att göra det rätta eller kommer pressen att bli för stor?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edgar Degas.You will discover his labour with Portrait of hilaire rené Degas, race horses, ballet rehearsal on the set.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherland painter, Vincent van Gogh.You will discover his labour with Self-portrait, Memory of the garden at Etten, Van Gogh’s chair.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Construction of the cathedral began in 1247 and was only finished in 1880 after an interruption that lasted more than 300 years. Ribbed vaults and flying buttresses, the film explores the architectural vocabulary of the gothic style and its building methods. It reveals the most recent contribution of metal to architecture. It demonstrates how this cathedral that embodies German unity is at the same time archetypal of the Gothic style and of a 19th century building.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: François Boucher (1703-1770) is the archetypal French Rococo painter. He paints mythological themes tinged with gallantry, for example in the beautiful “Diane resting after her Bath” at the Louvre Museum. His patron was Madame de Pompadour, whose portrait he painted many times. Influenced by the Enlightenment movement, he devoted himself to Chinese themes (“The Chinese Garden”), to pastoral landscape (“Charms of Country Life”) and to a certain sensual Orientalism (“Brown Odalisque”).Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Léonard De Vinci est le peintre Italien de la renaissance le plus célèbre. Il possède un talent inégalable (peintre, sculpteur, architecte, ingénieur, urbaniste, mathématicien, botaniste, philosophe, inventeur,…) Il a considérablement influencé l’histoire de l’art. Son usage de la technique Sfumato et du clair-obscur son encore étudié aujourd’hui. La « Mona Lisa » et « La Cène » exposé au Louvre et dans l'église Santa Maria delle Grazie qui apparaissent dans cet épisode font partie de ses peintures les plus renommé, admiré et parodié à travers le monde.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Leonardo: The Mystery of the Lost Portrait
programme.desc: In 2008, the chance discovery in the South of Italy of an ancient portrait with strangely familiar features takes the art world by storm. Could this be an unknown self-portrait by Leonardo da Vinci? Controversy erupts among the experts. The implications of such a discovery have far-reaching consequences for our understanding of the work of this great Renaissance master.

programme.title: Manet - Degas, a troubled friendship
programme.desc: In 1917 the art world is ablaze: the famous painter and sculptor Edgar Degas has just died, leaving behind him a collection rich of dozens of works from Edouard Manet.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private tour takes you on a tour of the "Picasso Masterpieces" exhibition at the National Picasso Museum in Paris. This exhibition tells the story of how Picasso's works became important collector's items for everyone. Picasso himself questioned the notion of "masterpieces". He concluded that there is not only one way to make a work a true masterpiece. During this private tour you will be able to discover or rediscover some of his works such as "The young ladies of Avignon" or "Women at their toilet".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.sub-title: The City of Architecture and Heritage
programme.desc: The City of Architecture and Heritage is a place dedicated to the art of building, its challenges, its eras, its styles, and its great masters. How are the major buildings of our time and of the past designed? Why and for whom were they built? The museum brings together a collection that allows you to navigate through centuries of architecture, to admire masterpieces usually out of sight, and to understand the great evolutions over the ages, from the 12th century to the present day.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.sub-title: Le Message Biblique - Dans l’œil de Marc Chagall
programme.desc: Museum Tour is a series that invites the viewer to discover unique which, for the artists chosen, have been incubators of creativity and a source of inspiration. Under their patronage, some of those sites have been turned into museums or foundations where their memory and work have picked up a life of their own.Each of the episodes will tell the story uniting the artist with a particular place, seeking intimacy in the process.This show’s agenda is decidedly visual. Works of art and the places in which they’re set will be filmed in such a way as to arouse strong emotions, thus placing the viewer in the spot, as if they were present in the flesh. This angle for the spectacular and search for beauty will enhance the accessibility of the series for an uninformed audience.A family-friendly documentary series which, beyond the fascinating information provided, offers a sight, sound and emotional journey into a captivating, palpable and contemporary form.

programme.title: The Villa Cavrois
programme.desc: Manifesto architecture, the Villa Cavrois is the emblematic work of the architect Robert Mallet-Stevens, a figure of modernism.

programme.title: Firminy by Le Corbusier
programme.desc: The Firminy site represents one of the strong ideas of Le Corbusier, the merger and coexistence between three human activities: cultural life and leisure, sports, and worship.

programme.title: Women Painters, four centuries of struggle
programme.desc: Do the names of Rosa Bonheur or Artemisia Gentileschi ring any bell to you? Despite their skills, female painters were for long time ignored by art historians and remain unknown to the public. This documentary recalls the destinies and masterpieces of those women, between the 16th and the 20th century. Who are they? And what did they bring to the art field?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Située sur la place Trafalgar Square à Londres, la Galerie Nationale est la maison d’une des plus grandes collections d’art Européennes. Celle-ci contient plus de 2000 peintures, allant du Moyen âge jusqu’au début des années 2000.Vous pourrez admirer des méthodes d’art et des œuvres d’artistes uniques au monde, comme la remarquable peinture flamande (Van Eyck, Vermeer), l’impressionnisme français (Monet, Cézanne) et surtout les maîtres anglais de l’art comme Hogart et Turner.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Johnson Wax Administrative Buildings stand as a masterpiece of Frank Lloyd Wright, one of the greatest architects of the 20th century. At first glance, the building surprises: no windows but Pyrex facades, long brick walls, curves. Everywhere it hides, you don't know where to enter. Seen from above, it has this streamlined profile like the fuselage of an airplane or the hull of a boat. Seen from below, it hides and protects. Closed to the solicitations of the outside world, it is the world - a place that encourages concentration and work. A self-sufficient space. And yet, there is nothing oppressive in this place that promotes concentration. It is a sensual place, with warm colors - the famous Cherokee red invented by Frank Lloyd Wright - and rounded volumes. The architect had promised Johnson a building where everyone could feel like they were in a pine forest. He imagined a forest of tree-shaped columns: a metal base, a very thin cylindrical column that rises, widening to end in.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous nous rendons dans la banlieue Sud de Paris. C’est dans un quartier tranquille que l’artiste Elias Crespin se rend chaque matin pour rejoindre son studio. L’artiste d’origine vénézuélienne, y a établi ses quartiers depuis près de 5 ans et y façonnent ses créations un peu particulières. Ses sculptures sont composées de figures géométriques simples, des lignes, triangles, carrés ou cercles, qui flottent dans l’espace suspendus à des fils presque invisibles.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Russian painter, Vassily Kandinsky. You will discover his labour with Old city n°2, Park of Saint-cloud, Rider (improvisation n°12).

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Jean-Honoré Fragonard.You will discover his labour with Psyche showing her sisters her gifts from cupid, The storm, Night scene or the Beggar’s dream.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Paul Sérusier spent his entire summer of 1888 painting with Paul Gauguin in Pont-Aven, Brittany. This master of colour gave invaluable advice to the young Sérusier, who was part of the new generation of painters known as the Post-Impressionists. The Impressionists favoured the visual sensation of the motif, but they had not broken with the illusionist rendering of nature.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Lucas Cranach l’Ancien (v. 1472-1553) est un artiste majeur de la Renaissance germanique, actif à Wittenberg dans la première moitié du XVIe s. Peintre officiel de Frédéric le Sage, prince électeur de Saxe, il est proche du réformateur Martin Luther. Au-delà des thèmes bibliques, il s’intéresse particulièrement à la représentation du nu féminin, comme dans l’Adam et Eve de Besançon ou les fameuses Trois Grâces, récemment acquises par le musée du Louvre grâce à un appel aux dons.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Dans le quartier de Palmeiras à Sao Paulo, une ancienne usine aligne ses ateliers du début du XXème siècle avec d’étranges blocs de béton qui se dressent face à la ville et à ses tours. Un centre social et culturel destiné aux employés du commerce. Son architecte Lina Bo Bardi préfère parler d’une "citadelle du loisir

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Museo del Prado in Madrid holds one of the biggest collections of paintings in the world. The “Garden of Delights”, a triptych by Hieronymus Bosch, is one of its jewels. But naturally it is the Spanish School which predominates, with masterpieces by Velasquez and Goya. Look at Velasquez’s famous “Las Meninas” in which the painter portrays himself next to the Infanta and her followers. And admire the sensuous beauty of Goya’s “La Maja Desnuda” or the political force of “El Tres de Mayo”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rembrandt est largement considéré comme le plus grand peintre Néerlandais du 17ème siècle. Il est maître dans l’usage des lumières, particulièrement dans la technique du clair-obscur, c’est un dessinateur exceptionnellement talentueux. Le travail de Rembrandt a été considérablement influencé par les événements dramatique de sa vie ( La mort de sa femme, sa faillite financière, etc..). Dans cette exposition vous allez découvrir ses peintures les plus célèbres exposés au Louvre, comme « Bethsabée au bain tenant la lettre de David » ,mais également exposé à Mauritshuis avec « La Leçon d'anatomie du docteur Tulp » ou encore ces fameux autoportraits.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: The Villa Cavrois
programme.desc: Manifesto architecture, the Villa Cavrois is the emblematic work of the architect Robert Mallet-Stevens, a figure of modernism.

programme.title: Firminy by Le Corbusier
programme.desc: The Firminy site represents one of the strong ideas of Le Corbusier, the merger and coexistence between three human activities: cultural life and leisure, sports, and worship.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the "Caravaggio" exhibition at the Jacquemart André Museum in Paris.This is the first exhibition of the artist in Paris since 1965 and includes some of his masterpieces such as "Judith Beheading Holofernes". This provocative Italian painter was a still life specialist and this is what we will see in works such as "The Lute Player".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les légendes de la scène et de l'écran, Charles Dance et Geraldine James, rejoignent les experts en antiquités Natasha Raskin et Will Axon pour cette excursion dans le Wiltshire.Charles trouve une paire de vases en argent de l'époque édouardienne qu'il espère rentabiliser lors d'une vente aux enchères dans l'Essex. Geraldine, elle, tombe sur un homme dans la rue avec un secrétaire Empire français du XIXe siècle. Il lui en coûte une petite fortune - le pari sera-t-il gagnant ?Charles se retrouve dans le cockpit d'un très vieil hélicoptère tandis que Geraldine apprend comment un petit quartier de Swindon datant de 170 ans a influencé la création du NHS moderne.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: Throughout the first half of the 20th century, the Marmottan Museum was a center of First Empire art. We go there to admire the magnificent collection of Paul Marmottan, and to relive the nostalgia of the great Napoleonic era, its imperial splendor, its past glories. But little by little, the Marmottan Museum is becoming a showcase for another style of art, less classic, more avant-garde: impressionism. In 1993, the museum changed its name: it became the Musée Marmottan-Monet.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.sub-title: Le Domaine des Collettes - Dans l’œil d'Auguste Renoir
programme.desc: Museum Tour is a series that invites the viewer to discover unique which, for the artists chosen, have been incubators of creativity and a source of inspiration. Under their patronage, some of those sites have been turned into museums or foundations where their memory and work have picked up a life of their own.Each of the episodes will tell the story uniting the artist with a particular place, seeking intimacy in the process.This show’s agenda is decidedly visual. Works of art and the places in which they’re set will be filmed in such a way as to arouse strong emotions, thus placing the viewer in the spot, as if they were present in the flesh. This angle for the spectacular and search for beauty will enhance the accessibility of the series for an uninformed audience.A family-friendly documentary series which, beyond the fascinating information provided, offers a sight, sound and emotional journey into a captivating, palpable and contemporary form.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures takes you on a journey to discover the unsuspected secrets and treasures of the National Assembly in France. Some of the most delicate works are kept in the greatest secrecy. But this place, which is the temple of the French democracy, opens its doors to us exceptionally today. We will make you discover this emblematic universe, more known for its political episodes than for the treasures that it shelters.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The Birth of Venus... a masterpiece; central to Botticelli's oeuvre and the culmination of Florentine Neoplatonism.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: Where do we start when we want to talk about such a famous painting as Velázquez “Las Meninas”? There is an incredibly huge bibliography on this painting, to the point that it is almost utopian to think or hope we can document ourselves on everything in and about it... From the late 1800s to the early 2000s, dozens of books have come out all over the world specifically and solely devoted to this one, single painting. A parallel literary current has even developed around the “enigmas” and “mysteries” connected with “Las Meninas”.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Peintre originaire de Florence en Italie, Sandro Botticelli est considéré comme l’un des peintres Italiens les plus connus du 15ème siècle. Proche de la famille Medici, il est admiré et renommé pour ses portraits et ses peintures de femmes nues tout droit inspirées de la mythologie grecques comme le majestic tableau « La naissance de Vénus », exhibé dans la Gallery Uffizi à Florence, et également présent dans cet épisode.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: This famous art gallery in Berlin holds one of the world’s leading collections of European works by Old Masters. Here you can find “The Fountain of Youth” by Cranach the Elder, or the earthy “Netherlandish Proverbs” illustrated by Bruegel. Allow yourself to be tempted by the sensuality of Correggio (“Leda and the Swan”) or of Titian (“Venus with Organist”), by the poetry of “The Glass of Wine”, a genre painting by Vermeer, or by the gracious “Iris or the Dance” by Watteau. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: En plein essor capitaliste, Scott et Barlow créent pour la gare de Saint Pancras à Londres, la plus grande voûte métallique, adossée a un luxueux hôtel néogothique.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Erik Desmazières. Il est l’un des artistes graveurs les plus connus en France, et il est exposé à travers le monde. Il a apporté à cette discipline un peu désuète, une forme de modernité, grâce à ses paysages fantastiques imbibés de science-fiction remarqués tout de suite par les collectionneurs. Membre de l’Académie Française des Beaux-Arts depuis 2008, Erik Desmazières s’est tourné ces dernières années vers des paysages réalistes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edouard Manet.You will discover his labour with Lola de valence, Olympia, Eel and red mullet.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Paul Cezanne. You will discover his labour with his still-life, mill on the Couleuvre at Pontoise, Young girl with doll.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.desc: Massage studio will show you the best massage techniques in places which will make you dream. Let us take care of you! Lay down, relax and forget all your problems.

programme.desc: Watch beautiful landscapes from all over the world !

programme.desc: Nurture the body AND the mind with Spiritual Sports.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Root to Rise: Balance, Twist, Hamstrings
programme.desc: Learn to stay open, no matter what happens, with the Root to Rise sequence. This practice provides an opportunity to explore your capacity for receiving energy, while building strength and confidence. When you maintain a connection to grounded energy, you can heighten your ability to stay present in every moment.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" focuses on a muscle strengthening and mobility session, carefully designed to relax and energize the body. Guillaume and Sabrina start with a full warm-up, emphasizing movements for the neck, shoulders, and chest to release tension. Each exercise aims to improve movement range and posture, fostering a connection between the brain and body to prevent injuries. Through progressive rotations and stretches, the session stimulates joint mobility, especially in the knees and ankles. This comprehensive and nurturing approach is ideal for reconnecting with oneself while gently strengthening the body.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Create Your Calm: A Grounding Flow for Hips and Hamstrings
programme.desc: Cultivate a sense of peace and stability with the Create Your Calm sequence. This restorative flow stays low to allow for a deeper connection to the earth and its grounding energy. Connect with your heart more completely and welcome a softer awareness with this gentle practice.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est à Samia de jouer. À 31 ans, cette prof de sciences troque régulièrement ses livres de classe contre des bouquins de déco. Pour elle, la décoration, c'est un peu comme une histoire d'amour. Avec son mari, Samia a d’ailleurs acheté une maison qu'elle est en train de rénover. C’est l'occasion pour elle de s'en donner à cœur joie et de tout repenser à son goût.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: In north-west Corsica, Balagne, nicknamed “the garden of the island”, combines heritage and breathtaking scenery. From Saint-Florent, , a charming Mediterranean port, to the mysterious citadel of Calvi, and through Pigna, a hilltop village with an artistic soul, each stop reveals an authentic Corsica. This journey through unspoilt nature is shared with islanders proud of their land and traditions.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Baie de Somme boasts an exceptional natural and historical heritage. From the emblematic medieval town of Saint-Valery-sur-Somme to the gardens of Valloires Abbey and the colorful villas of Mers-les-Bains, this episode reveals the richness of the Picardy coastline. Amid marshes, dunes and vast stretches of wilderness, the bay is also home to remarkable wildlife, best discovered alongside the enthusiasts who strive to preserve its beauty.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Haut-RhinWelcome to Alsace, a land of tradition endowed with a heritage of incredible beauty! In the Haut-Rhin, we visit the mediaeval town of Riquewihr, whose wine is exported throughout the world, and Éguisheim, a veritable picture postcard village. Finally, we take a stroll through Colmar, the ''little Venice'' of Alsace.Directed by: Nicolas Coutand (season 1, France, 2014).

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine un poisson de la Méditerranée, le rouget. Au menu : filets de rouget avec de la purée d'avocat et des carottes au cumin, et mille-feuille de rouget avec des légumes printaniers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes Delphine Malachard, who is gluten intolerant. Together, they cook gluten-free recipes. On the menu: chocolate soufflé and vanilla and red fruit financiers.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In our season premiere we tackle the riveting question: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we venture into the lab to uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance. Then we take this theoretical knowledge into the real world, visiting a high-performance training facility where professional NHL athletes are honing their skills. There, we join forces with Ben Prentiss, founder of Prentiss Hockey Performance, to not only witness these athletes in action but also to understand how the principles of peak performance can translate into our daily lives for enhanced strength and well-being. We hear from the athletes themselves including Stanley Cup Champions and All-Star players about their philosophy on what health means to them. This episode offers an insider's look into the world of elite training, demystifying the science and practices that enable ath.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part I
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health?

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part II
programme.desc: We're still in New Zealand, where we look at the scientific and emotional benefits of water, illustrated by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection with aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we discover how New Zealand's abundant waters are more than just a natural spectacle; they're a source of holistic health and well-being.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part I
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. We discover the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas and the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part II
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

Use this sequence to detoxify, build confidence and restore a sense of balance and wellbeing to take off the mat and into the rest of your day.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" offers a multisport session that combines several disciplines, from gymnastics and swimming to basketball. The session incorporates movements inspired by different sports, providing a varied and enjoyable workout. The exercises target both the lower and upper body while including movements that make for an effective cardio workout. With an energetic and friendly atmosphere, this fun session is perfect for getting active while having a good time.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Reflect and Connect: Open Your Shoulders, Hips and Hamstrings
programme.desc: Are you ready to fly? Reflect and Connect will engage your whole body with a series of poses that first calm and center, and then awaken and inspire. Build energy and a sense of security before channeling your curiosity and testing your limits.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: C’est à Grégory de prouver que l'As de la déco, c'est lui. Cet animateur pour enfants de 37 ans, originaire d'Etterbeek, a une personnalité haute en couleurs. En tout cas, c'est ce que disent ses amis. Et aux quatre coins de son intérieur se trouvent les objets que Grégory pense, réalise, couds ou customise à son gré.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous allons voyager au Mexique avec les fajitas ! Un plat typique de la cuisine tex-mex. On va préparer ensemble des tortillas (galettes de maïs). Et pour la suite, des fajitas avec du poulet, des poivrons et des épices.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana cooks with the interpreter of the flagship title of Frozen: Anaïs Delva. Together, they will prepare two 100% vegetarian recipes, a philosophy adopted by the singer. On the menu: grilled zucchini fettucini, white beans with pesto and a vegetarian burger. Proof that it's possible to enjoy vegetarian dishes without going hungry!

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: A land of character, Corrèze is full of hidden treasures. From Collonges-la-Rouge, a flamboyant red sandstone town, to the Cistercian abbey of Aubazine, and through Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne and its medieval heritage, each place bears witness to a rich past. But beyond its monuments, this region is also seductive for its untouched nature and its passionate inhabitants, guardians of an age-old legacy.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Haut-RhinWelcome to Alsace, a land of tradition endowed with a heritage of incredible beauty! In the Haut-Rhin, we visit the mediaeval town of Riquewihr, whose wine is exported throughout the world, and Éguisheim, a veritable picture postcard village. Finally, we take a stroll through Colmar, the ''little Venice'' of Alsace.Directed by: Nicolas Coutand (season 1, France, 2014).

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo cuisine la reine des protéines végétales : la lentille. Bonne pour la santé, digeste et délicieuse, elle remplace la viande et le poisson. Nous allons préparer des galettes de lentilles corail aux épices, avec une sauce au yaourt et à la menthe. Et pour la suite, un classique de la cuisine française : une salade de lentilles vertes avec de la saucisse de Morteau.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo reçoit son amie Séverine Ferrer, animatrice et comédienne, pour préparer des tartes. Au menu : le gâteau patate (spécialité réunionnaise avec de la patate douce) et une tarte "Luarraine

programme.title: Cake Boss: Next Great Baker
programme.desc: This year, the jury and candidates meet at the Musée des Arts Forains for the third edition of the culinary competition, reserved for young pastry professionals. Christophe Michalak, Christophe Adam, Philippe Urraca and Pierre Marcolini will judge the work done during the weekly tests, in an attempt to find the rare pearl among Tristan, Matthieu, Nina, Cédric, Morgane, Gaëlle, Nathan and Gregory, eight talented candidates with a passion for their craft. On the menu: technique and creativity in the service of gourmet delights.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part I
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health?

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part II
programme.desc: We're still in New Zealand, where we look at the scientific and emotional benefits of water, illustrated by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection with aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we discover how New Zealand's abundant waters are more than just a natural spectacle; they're a source of holistic health and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part I
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. We discover the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas and the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part II
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Vi begynner på den lille øya Batan, der vi treffer en unik slange og en utbredt landkrabbe.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: En ny klasse starter på Pandaskolen. De små pandaungene har tilbrakt hele livet på fødeavdelingen, men skal nå for første gang våge seg ut i en verden full av nye inntrykk, nye lyder og pandaferdigheter de må lære. Mini Ling Lang, den eldste av sommerungene, oppdager at mora hennes er en flink klatrer og prøver å følge i hennes fotspor. Su Jin Junior er egenrådig, og mora hans holder han i sjakk med en streng og direkte undervisningsstil. De små tvillingene er for unge til å begynne å klatre, men gir alt når snøen kommer. Snøvær betyr ikke at skolen er avlyst, det betyr at timene blir vanskeligere. Mens de minste ungene begynner på skolen, er Tian Tians unge oppe i fjellene og nærmer seg slutten av undervisningen…og kommer litt nærmere et liv i naturen.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Pula, leopardlederen over kongerikets mørke hjerte, står overfor en tøff avgjørelse mellom ekte kjærlighet og arven hennes. Når Pula føder Motshidi, er det hennes siste sjanse for et dynasti. Blue Eyes, Motshidis far, er ikke til å stole på. Han har tidligere drept unger. Pula må beskytte og trene Motshidi til å ta sin rettmessige plass i kongeriket mens Pulas helsetilstand forverres.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Den etterlengtede spinoffen til den legendariske The Incredible Dr. Pol-serien er endelig her! Med dr. Pol og hans sønn Charles i spissen, slår Pol-familiens tre generasjoner seg sammen for å øke sitt dyrekjære imperium og ta fatt på et ambisiøst nytt prosjekt: Å transformere 1416 mål med ubebygd land til en fullt funksjonell familiegård!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Familien Pol må plante ferdig høyfrø, og de setter opp bikuber!

programme.title: Elephant Planet
programme.desc: Over hele Afrika og Asia tilpasser fire elefantfamilier seg underveis, under veiledning av sine matriarkalske ledere. Hvert skritt setter instinktene og intelligensen deres på prøve, mens de jobber hardt for å videreføre arven ved å sikre de nyfødtes overlevelse. Samas-flokken, en sjelden flokk med ørkenelefanter, tåler nådeløs varme og ubarmhjertig tørke i en desperat jakt på vann. I India bærer en nyfødt elefantunge flokkens framtid mens den beveger seg gjennom skoger som er utsatt for stadige miljøendringer. På savannen i Kenya lever Tembo-familien side om side med dødelige rovdyr og kjemper for å passe på ungen sin. Og på Borneo må Gaja-flokken finne veien gjennom en regnskog i endring, tilpasse seg skiftende vandreruter og samtidig lære de unge, uerfarne medlemmene ferdighetene de trenger for å overleve.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: I Sør-Afrikas villmark blir dyrene desperate i de tørre vintermånedene. Sultne krokodiller sloss mot en farlig gruppe flodhester, flodhestene prøver seg på en gruppe hannløver, en honninggrevling kjemper for livet mot leoparder, og villhunder skaper komplett kaos hvor enn de går.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Når savannen blir en slagmark ser vi på fra sidelinjen når en leopard blir trengt opp i et hjørne av en løveflokk. En ung impala blir kastet opp i luften av en flodhest, to hyener prøver å drukne hverandre og et jordsvin står ansikt til ansikt med en brunhyene.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Livet i den afrikanske bushen er et strategispill for å overleve for de som bor der. Men det mødrene som viser eksepsjonelt mot og styrke når det gjelder å beskytte sine små. De frodige gresslettene byr på gjemmesteder for babyene men også perfekt kamuflasje for luskende rovdyr. Vi ser på de utrolige måtene disse modige matriarkene forer, forsvarer og oppdrar sine barn.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards
programme.desc: I viltreservatet Mashatu i Botswana, et av de siste fristedene for frittgående leoparder, føder en mor to unger. Hun vil gjøre alt for å beskytte dem. Men når klimaendringer strammer grepet, forsvinner ressurser, og en tøff leopardkrig er i emming. Denne filmen er basert på tre år med nøye observasjon, og avdekker sjeldne og utrolige bilder av oppførsel som ikke tidligere har blitt dokumentert, og tilbyr et helt nytt innblikk i motstandsdyktigheten og hemmelighetene til denne sky arten.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Turister fanger de beste øyeblikkene i villmarken med telefonene sine, og de store kattedyrere står øverst på alles ønskeliste på safari. Hold deg fast når en elefant angriper med en løve på støttennene. Se hannleoparder kjempe om revir, og vær obs på en leopardmors jaktskole. Geparder konfronterer krokodiller for å beskytte måltidet sitt. Store bøffelflokker samles mens en enslig løve viser hvorfor han er kongen.

programme.title: Den grønnøyde leoparden
programme.desc: Vi følger leoparden Toto, som uvanlig nok har blågrønne øyne, gjennom de første årene i hennes liv. Da må hun lære alt som trengs for å overleve.

programme.title: Elephant Planet
programme.desc: Over hele Afrika og Asia tilpasser fire elefantfamilier seg underveis, under veiledning av sine matriarkalske ledere. Hvert skritt setter instinktene og intelligensen deres på prøve, mens de jobber hardt for å videreføre arven ved å sikre de nyfødtes overlevelse. Samas-flokken, en sjelden flokk med ørkenelefanter, tåler nådeløs varme og ubarmhjertig tørke i en desperat jakt på vann. I India bærer en nyfødt elefantunge flokkens framtid mens den beveger seg gjennom skoger som er utsatt for stadige miljøendringer. På savannen i Kenya lever Tembo-familien side om side med dødelige rovdyr og kjemper for å passe på ungen sin. Og på Borneo må Gaja-flokken finne veien gjennom en regnskog i endring, tilpasse seg skiftende vandreruter og samtidig lære de unge, uerfarne medlemmene ferdighetene de trenger for å overleve.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Det er morsdag! Dr. Pol og dr. Brenda skynder seg for å hjelpe dyr som strever med å føde, mens dr. Lisa behandler ei ku med fødselsskader. To valper får vaksiner, og to eldre hunder trenger hjelp med å fjerne pigger. Morsdag nærmer seg, og dr. Pol og Charles ordner en overraskelse til Diane og Beth.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Et dokumentarliknende innblikk i privatlivet til veterinærene våre. Dr. Pol og dr. Lisa behandler to hunder som trenger hjelp med å føde.

programme.title: Penguin Planet
programme.desc: Antarktis er jordas kaldeste og mest ugjestmilde kontinent, et sted der bare de mest hardføre skapningene kan overleve. Her finner vi pingvinen, en iskledd overlever som er selve symbolet på livet i polarområdene og perfekt tilpasset et liv på grensen til det mulige. Men det finnes også en utfordrer. Den afrikanske pingvinen har valgt varme sandstrender som hjem og lever under helt motsatte forhold. Livet i utkanten av pingvinenes utbredelsesområde byr på store utfordringer. Farlige rovdyr patruljerer jaktområdene deres, mens nye fiender truer dem på land. Fra Antarktis' iskalde klipper til Kappområdets solstekte kyst er pingviner skapt for å holde ut.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Med Botswanas vidstrakte og uberørte villmark som kulisse følger "Big Little Giants" Afrikas yngste dyr mens de tar sine første skritt inn i en utfordrende verden preget av tørke, rovdyr og eldgamle migrasjonsruter. Fra en nyfødt elefant som lærer å holde tritt med flokken, til sjakalunger som setter instinktene på prøve og gepardunger som forbereder seg på livet i forbløffende fart, hver historie utspiller seg gjennom intime øyeblikk preget av læring og tap. Godt hjulpet av foreldre, søsken og instinkt må de unge dyrene raskt tilpasse seg, ellers havner de på etterskudd. Gjennom fantastiske landskap og nærbilder ser du hvordan mot, familiebånd og motstandskraft er avgjørende for å overleve i den mest sårbare fasen av livet i naturen.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards
programme.desc: I viltreservatet Mashatu i Botswana, et av de siste fristedene for frittgående leoparder, føder en mor to unger. Hun vil gjøre alt for å beskytte dem. Men når klimaendringer strammer grepet, forsvinner ressurser, og en tøff leopardkrig er i emming. programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Pula, leopardlederen over kongerikets mørke hjerte, står overfor en tøff avgjørelse mellom ekte kjærlighet og arven hennes. Når Pula føder Motshidi, er det hennes siste sjanse for et dynasti. Blue Eyes, Motshidis far, er ikke til å stole på. Han har tidligere drept unger. Pula må beskytte og trene Motshidi til å ta sin rettmessige plass i kongeriket mens Pulas helsetilstand forverres.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: I Sør-Afrikas villmark blir dyrene desperate i de tørre vintermånedene. Sultne krokodiller sloss mot en farlig gruppe flodhester, flodhestene prøver seg på en gruppe hannløver, en honninggrevling kjemper for livet mot leoparder, og villhunder skaper komplett kaos hvor enn de går.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Når savannen blir en slagmark ser vi på fra sidelinjen når en leopard blir trengt opp i et hjørne av en løveflokk. En ung impala blir kastet opp i luften av en flodhest, to hyener prøver å drukne hverandre og et jordsvin står ansikt til ansikt med en brunhyene.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Livet i den afrikanske bushen er et strategispill for å overleve for de som bor der. Men det mødrene som viser eksepsjonelt mot og styrke når det gjelder å beskytte sine små. De frodige gresslettene byr på gjemmesteder for babyene men også perfekt kamuflasje for luskende rovdyr. Vi ser på de utrolige måtene disse modige matriarkene forer, forsvarer og oppdrar sine barn.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Det er sommer i Michigan, noe som betyr at det er på tide å presse sammen litt høy! Det er en utmattende prosess, men dr. Pol, Charles og Ben klarer å klippe engen deres, som er det første trinnet i ballepressingen. Men et overraskende regnvær kan ødelegge årets høyinnsanking. De håper på sol så avlingen deres ikke ødelegges før de kan presse baller. I mellomtiden bringer Pol-familien inn sitt neste dyr til gården - en emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Pol-klanen installerer et nytt gjerde og drar til smådyrauksjonen.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Kamuflasje, mimikk og sniking er verktøy som brukes av de smarteste dyrene på planeten. programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Enten de skal unnslippe farlige rovdyr eller bekjempe tøffe rivaler, så er ikke alltid rå styrke nok til å lykkes. Vi møter noen av planetens mest unike dyr som tar i bruk utrolige superkrefter, som akrobatikk som trosser døden, hemmelige sanser og skjulte våpen, for å overleve.
